notes.title: Faith of Fate: 0.7 PART 1
notes.content:
Faith of Fate 0.7 [b]PART 1[/b] is here!! Giving the players a little bite of what will come in the [b]PART 2[/b] and also making sure everything works properly, hope you like it!!   ❤️ 💙 

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Chests And Keys To The Game
[*] Added 5 Brand New Items
[*] Added New Foreground Decorations To All The Rooms 
[*] Added 2 New Bosses With Very Unique Abilities
[*] Added A New "Unlocks" Section On The Main Menu
[*] Sacrifice Item Now Interacts With Sacrifice Rooms
[*] The Progress On The Boss Fights Is Now Saved When
    You Reach The Half Of The Health Bar Of The Boss
[*] Added A New Weak Version Of The Hat Enemy  
[*] Added 10 New Room Layouts To The Game
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] First Room Got Redesign
[*] Many Room Layouts Got Changed
[*] Bosses' Health Bar Got Redesign
[*] Bosses' Health Has Been Increased
[*] Sacrifice Room Pool Has Been Modified
[*] Fixed A very Rare Crash On The PONG minigame 
[*] The Violin Got Reworked Once More :)
[*] Sacrifice Chalice Success chanse increased to 90%
[*] Both Final Bosses Got Reworked and Rebalanced Making
    Them More Unique, Harder And Also More Fair To Play 
[*] Many Items Have Been Highly Reworked And Rebalanced
[*] Boncy Ball Item Finally Works Properly!! :D
[*] Adjusted Balance On The Game
[*] Several Bugs Fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Faith of Fate: 0.6.6.6
notes.content:
Faith of Fate 0.6.6.6 is here!! The last patch before Story Update, that tries to add a lot of new features and solve the most of the inconsistencies of the game, hope you really like it!!

[b]Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Chests And Keys To The Game
[*] Added A New GUI That Shows Your Gold And Keys
[*] Many Items Have Been Highly Reworked And Rebalanced
     The Following Items: Marry Me?, Meat, Panic! And Sausage
[*] Removed Bob's Pre-Ending For Not Contributing To The Story
[*] All The Bosses In The Tear Place Are Got Reworked
[*] Charles Boss Fight Also Got Reworked
[*] Squishy Got Cat Ears
[*] Added 15 Brand New Items
[*] Added 5 New Achievements
[*] Added A Total Of 17 New Unlockables
[*] Added A Feature For Changing Characters
[*] Added An Animation For Drop Spawning
[*] Added A New Death Animation On Bosses
[*] Added A Story Fix When Killing Some Bosses
[*] Shot Effects Have Been Reworked And Rebalanced
[*] Enemy Collision Should Work A Bit Better Now 
[*] Fixed Hundreds Of Minor Bugs And Crashes!!
[*] Adjusted Balance On The Game
[/list]

notes.title: Faith of Fate: Prerelease
notes.content: Faith of Fata will finally make its debut on Steam this 2019, the game will release soon and will count with a 30% discount. We appreciate your support to take this great step and we hope you continue supporting our community
